data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, the name Kezia means 'cedar tree'. In the Bible, there are several women named Kezia, including a wife of King Joash and a wife of Job. The name represents strength, stability, and longevity. The name Kezia carries the meaning “Cedar tree” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Kezia usually hope their child will grow to embody cedar tree and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's enduring love and support.
data.etymology: Kezia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Cedar tree.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kezia total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: קזיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קזיה היא שם עברי שמקורו בקסם ובניחוח. הניחוח הוא ריח נעים שמתפשט באוויר, והוא נמצא מספר פעמים בתנ"ך. על פי המסורת היהודית, קזיה הוא אחד משמותיה של האישה, והוא נחשב לשם יפה ומרגיע.

in_greek.name: Κεζία
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Κεζία είναι ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος קזיה, που σημαίνει μυρωδία ή άρωμα. Στο βιβλικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα Κεζία αναφέρεται στη μυρωδία που χρησιμοποιούταν στις θυσίες και στις ιεροτελεστίες. Το όνομα Κεζία είναι σύμβολο της πνευματικής αρωματικής και της θυσίας.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kezia holds cultural significance as it is derived from the Hebrew language. In ancient times, cedar trees were prized for their durability, strength, and pleasant fragrance. By naming a child Kezia, parents may be expressing their hope that their child will embody these qualities and grow to be strong, stable, and respected members of their community.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Bible, Kezia is a name associated with faithfulness and resilience. The wife of King Joash was named Kezia, and she is known for her devotion to God and her strength in the face of adversity. Additionally, the wife of Job, whose name is also Kezia, demonstrates an unyielding faith in the face of suffering. By naming their child Kezia, parents may be hoping that their child will develop a strong spiritual foundation, one that allows them to withstand life's challenges and remain faithful to their beliefs.
